description: LOT B — Enriched messages: extend Message model, add ReactionMessage, update backend services/views/WS, build enriched React bubbles and input bar. Independent of FEAT-001 on the backend; depends on FEAT-001 only for the shared migrations sequence (run after FEAT-001 to avoid migration conflicts).
steps: 1. Extend Message model in backend/discussions/models.py. Add these fields after the existing 'texte' field: type (CharField max_length=10, default='texte', choices=[('texte','Texte'),('image','Image'),('fichier','Fichier'),('vocal','Vocal')]), fichier (FileField upload_to='messages/%Y/%m/', null=True, blank=True), nom_fichier (CharField max_length=255, blank=True), taille_fichier (PositiveIntegerField null=True, blank=True), duree_vocale (PositiveSmallIntegerField null=True, blank=True — seconds), en_reponse_a (ForeignKey 'self', null=True, blank=True, on_delete=SET_NULL, related_name='reponses'). Make texte blank=True (it can be empty for media messages). Keep max_length=2000.

2. Add ReactionMessage model to backend/discussions/models.py. Fields: message (FK Message, related_name='reactions', CASCADE), user (FK U, CASCADE), emoji (CharField max_length=8). Meta: constraints=[UniqueConstraint(fields=['message','user','emoji'], name='reaction_unique')], indexes=[Index(fields=['message'])].

3. Generate migration: cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py makemigrations discussions. Produces backend/discussions/migrations/0002_message_enrichi.py. Confirm default='texte' is present on the type field so existing rows are preserved. Confirm texte field gets blank=True added.

4. Extend serialiser_message() in backend/discussions/services.py. Add to returned dict: 'type': m.type, 'fichier_url': m.fichier.url if m.fichier else None, 'nom_fichier': m.nom_fichier, 'taille_fichier': m.taille_fichier, 'duree_vocale': m.duree_vocale, 'en_reponse_a': {'id': m.en_reponse_a.pk, 'texte': m.en_reponse_a.texte[:80], 'auteur_id': m.en_reponse_a.auteur_id} if m.en_reponse_a_id else None, 'reactions': []. Reactions list is populated by a separate annotated query when called from views (not from WS broadcast to keep it fast). Add a helper serialiser_reactions(msg_id, user_id) -> list of {emoji, nb, moi}. Use from .models import ReactionMessage with .values('emoji').annotate(nb=Count('id')).order_by('-nb') and a subquery for 'moi'.

5. Extend envoyer_message() in backend/discussions/services.py to accept optional type, fichier, nom_fichier, taille_fichier, duree_vocale, en_reponse_a_id params. Remove the 'if not texte: raise ValidationError' check — allow empty texte when type != 'texte'. Pass type through to Message.objects.create(). The WS data dict already includes 'message': serialiser_message(m, cid_propre) so type is broadcast automatically once serialiser_message includes it.

6. Add MessagesMediaView to backend/discussions/views.py: POST /conversations/<pk>/messages/media/. Accepts multipart/form-data with field 'fichier'. Validates mime type (image/*, audio/*) and size (<= 10MB — override per-view). Saves to Message.fichier via default storage. Returns {fichier_url, nom_fichier, taille_fichier}. No message created here — the client sends a second POST to /messages/ with the returned URL as fichier info. Actually simpler: create the Message directly with type derived from mime type (audio/* -> 'vocal', image/* -> 'image', else 'fichier'), return serialiser_message.

7. Add ReactionView to backend/discussions/views.py: POST/DELETE /conversations/<pk>/messages/<msg_id>/reactions/. Body: {emoji}. POST: get_or_create ReactionMessage(message_id=msg_id, user=request.user, emoji=emoji). DELETE: delete it. Validate emoji is 1-4 chars (emoji can be multi-codepoint but we cap at 8 bytes via model). After toggle, broadcast WS event {type:'reaction.maj', conversation:pk, message_id:msg_id} to conversation participants via diffuser().

8. Modify MessagesView.post in backend/discussions/views.py to accept multipart/form-data alongside JSON. Extract fichier from request.FILES.get('fichier') if present, determine type. Pass all fields to envoyer_message().

9. Update backend/discussions/urls.py to add: path('conversations/<int:pk>/messages/media/', views.MessagesMediaView.as_view()), path('conversations/<int:pk>/messages/<int:msg_id>/reactions/', views.ReactionView.as_view()).

10. Handle reaction.maj in frontend/src/temps-reel/TempsReel.jsx traiter() function: on type 'reaction.maj', invalidate ['messages', String(d.conversation)] so the bubble re-fetches reactions. Add invalidation: qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['messages', String(d.conversation)] }).

11. Add useReagir and useUploadMedia hooks to frontend/src/api/discussions.js. useReagir: useMutation that POSTs/DELETEs to /conversations/<convId>/messages/<msgId>/reactions/ with {emoji}; onSuccess invalidates ['messages', convId]. useUploadMedia: useMutation that POSTs FormData to /conversations/<convId>/messages/media/ and returns the message data.

12. Refactor frontend/src/pages/Conversation.jsx. Keep all existing state/effects/WS logic intact. Add state: enReponseA (null | message object), selectedFile (null | {file, previewUrl, type}), recording (bool), mediaRecorder ref. Add formatDuree(sec) util -> 'MM:SS'. Add grouper(liste) util -> array of {separateur?: string, message?} interleaved with date separators ('Aujourd\'hui', 'Hier', 'Lundi 14 oct.'). Use Intl.DateTimeFormat('fr-FR') for date formatting.

13. Create BulleTexte sub-component inside Conversation.jsx (or inline). When m.en_reponse_a: render a mini quoted div above the bubble text with left border style='borderLeft: 3px solid var(--accent-sec), paddingLeft: 0.5rem, marginBottom: 0.3rem, fontSize: 0.8rem, opacity: 0.8'. When m.reactions.length > 0: render emoji pills below the bubble using flex-wrap.

14. Create BulleImage sub-component: renders max-width 260px border-radius 0.75rem; click opens fullscreen modal (reuse .visionneuse CSS class already defined in theme.css). Below image: nom_fichier + taille formatée.
15. Create BulleFichier sub-component: icon chosen by extension (pdf->🔴, jpg/png->🟣, else 📄), nom_fichier, taille formatée, click -> window.open(fichier_url) for download.

16. Create BulleVocale sub-component: play/pause button (violet circle .plus CSS class), simulated waveform (20 bars of fixed heights using a deterministic hash of msg id), duration formatted MM:SS. Use HTMLAudioElement (new Audio(fichier_url)) stored in a ref, toggle play/pause on button click, update isPlaying state via onplay/onpause events.

17. Enrich the send form in Conversation.jsx. Add to state: enReponseA, selectedFile, isRecording, mediaRecorder ref, recordingChunks ref. Add 📎 button: <input type='file' accept='image/*,audio/*' hidden ref={fileInputRef} onChange={onFileSelected}> triggered by paperclip button click. Add 🎤 button: startRecording() calls navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({audio:true}), creates MediaRecorder, stores chunks. stopRecording() calls mediaRecorder.stop(), on dataavailable assembles Blob, sets selectedFile. When selectedFile: show preview strip above textarea (image thumbnail or audio filename) with × to clear. When enReponseA: show citation banner above textarea (quoted text, author name, × to clear). Add hover-reply button on each message: on hover show a Reply icon button at the edge; onClick sets enReponseA(m). Modify envoyerMessage() to: if selectedFile, call useUploadMedia mutation first, then send the returned message; if type='texte' with text, send via existing WS/REST path but include en_reponse_a_id if set.

18. Add date separators: wrap liste in grouper() before rendering; for each group item, if .separateur render <div className='separateur-date'> with the label, else render the appropriate bulle component. Add .separateur-date CSS inline style (or add to theme.css): text-align center, font-size 0.75rem, color var(--texte-doux), margin 0.5rem 0, display flex, gap 0.5rem, align-items center, ::before/::after pseudo-elements as horizontal rules.
acceptance_criteria: cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py check returns 0 issues
cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py migrate applies 0002_message_enrichi cleanly on SQLite
cd backend && .venv\Scripts\pytest.exe — all existing tests pass (serialiser_message change is backward-compatible — existing callers get extra fields, not fewer)
POST /conversations/<pk>/messages/media/ with an image file returns 201 with fichier_url
GET /conversations/<pk>/messages/ returns messages with type, fichier_url, reactions fields
cd frontend && npm run build — no build errors
Conversation.jsx renders image bubble, vocal bubble, file bubble, text bubble with quoted reply and emoji reactions without JS errors
